## Reconciled physical seam

Full fixed-axis swimmer/hull/berth extents, public world signatures, optical LOS and supplied local floors remain. The existing rib AABBs register/broadphase the curved obstacle; they are not a second collision surface.

The helper minimizes segment/full-box distance over slab-partitioned quadratics. Continuous conservative advancement uses its separating normal and a supporting-plane lower bound, not endpoint sampling. Every tangent is swept again across the supplied roster. Static overlap tolerance is 1 mm; approaching sweep separation is 1 µm; numerical tangency is at most 1e-12 m inward projection over the displacement. At most 64 distance evaluations per rib and eight world slide iterations; unresolved/exhausted travel is discarded. Actual vertical capsule intersection replaces the invisible flat support roof. Legacy geometry remains contained within the original boxes; no migration or relocation was introduced.

These are floating-point geometric bounds, not interval-arithmetic certification. Grazing contact has a spatial tolerance without a uniform time-error bound; conservative exhaustion can stop early. Existing terrain sampling and world-boundary behavior remain. Invalid shapes/deltas fail closed; nonfinite movement origins throw. Internal helper exports/constants are documented in [author evidence](POLISH-1-SLICE2-RIB.md); no consumer may infer rounded actor proxies or alter handling from this correction.
